author: hani
abstract: Holistic UX design intelligence for building clean, usable UI artifacts. Organizes 48 independently identifiable rules into 7 focused pillar references — Foundations, Layout & Hierarchy, Visual Design, Interaction & Motion, Navigation & IA, Content & Microcopy, and Accessibility & Inclusion — with mandatory agent instructions, pillar checklists, and a pre-delivery review workflow. The 23 Memorisely-derived additions retain direct reel provenance.
